brief:
The Quincy Institute has characterized Israel's emerging security strategy as expansionist and alarming, according to the organization's analysis. The doctrine represents a significant shift in how Israel frames its defensive posture and territorial approach.

The institute, which focuses on foreign policy, did not elaborate specific details of the doctrine in the available summary, but flagged the framework as raising serious concerns about regional stability and the trajectory of Israeli security policy.
title: Israel adopts expansionist security doctrine, Quincy Institute warns
